name: The Block Palm Springs
summary: The Block Palm Springs is downtown's premier lifestyle destination, combining upscale dining, boutique shopping, and world-class art installations in a walkable open-air setting. Anchored by the Kimpton Rowan hotel and featuring celebrated restaurants like 4 Saints Steakhouse and Il Corso, this cultural hub offers an authentic Palm Springs experience with iconic art pieces and breathtaking mountain views.
demographics: The Block Palm Springs attracts an affluent, culturally-engaged demographic with visitors typically ranging from upper-middle to high-income households. The trade area draws a diverse mix of local Palm Springs residents, seasonal visitors, and tourists seeking upscale dining and shopping experiences in the downtown core. Primary market segments include art enthusiasts, design-conscious shoppers aged 35-65, and luxury travelers staying at the Kimpton Rowan hotel. The center benefits from Palm Springs' reputation as a sophisticated desert destination, attracting visitors who value experiential retail, fine dining, and cultural amenities over traditional mall shopping.
description: The Block Palm Springs serves as the vibrant heartbeat of downtown Palm Springs, offering an inclusive encounter with the city's rich history, modern architecture, and cultural experiences. This open-air lifestyle destination seamlessly blends upscale shopping, fine dining, and artistic expression in a walkable downtown setting framed by stunning mountain views. Anchored by the luxurious Kimpton Rowan Palm Springs hotel with its celebrated rooftop bar, The Block features acclaimed restaurants including Il Corso, 4 Saints Steakhouse, Juniper Table, and Tommy Bahama Marlin Bar, providing diverse culinary experiences from fine dining to casual al fresco options. The center has become an art lover's paradise, showcasing iconic installations including the 26-foot tall Marilyn Monroe statue, Isabel statue, Colette Miller Angel Wings, and David Cerny Babies, all situated near renowned cultural institutions like the Palm Springs Art Museum and the new Agua Caliente Cultural Museum. Visitors can explore local boutiques alongside familiar retail favorites like H&M, West Elm, and Free People, while enjoying the endless blue skies and sophisticated atmosphere that make Palm Springs unlike any other destination.
